item.title: Joe Bryan and Casper De Norre visit MCT’s Half-Term Holiday Camps
item.description: Millwall FC First-Team duo Casper De Norre and Joe Bryan visited Millwall Community Trust’s (MCT) February Half-Term Holiday Camps at The Lions Centre. MCT runs in excess of 100 football and multisport courses across 13 weeks of the year in the London Boroughs of Lewisham and Southwark and across Kent. item.title: Kendall at the double as Under 21s beat Bristol City
item.description: Kevin Nugent’s men recorded a 2-1 home victory over Bristol City on Tuesday afternoon, in a match which featured numerous senior players for Millwall's Under 21s. Sheldon Kendall's two goals - one in either half - saw the three Professional Development League points remain at Calmont Road. item.title: Kevin Nugent speaks following Lions win
item.description: Under 21s Manager Kevin Nugent spoke to millwallfc.co.uk after the 2-1 Professional Development League triumph over Bristol City on Tuesday afternoon. Sheldon Kendall scored twice as The Lions saw off The Robins at Calmont Road. His overall assessment of the performance was that it was "a really good performance from start to finish" and that The Lions "had some good chances in the first-half" and could have put the game to bed in the early stages. item.title: Under 18s beaten at Colchester
item.description: Millwall's Under 18s were beaten 4-2 by Colchester United in the Professional Development League on Tuesday afternoon. Goals from a Trialist and Ndige kept The Lions competitive in Essex, but they were to suffer defeat at Florence Park. The reverse League fixture takes place this Saturday, as The Lions host The U's at Calmont Road.FixturesColchester United U18 Vs. Millwall U18 - Tue, Feb 17 2026, 13:00

item.title: Wes Harding keeps Plymouth clean sheet
item.description: Wes Harding was part of a Plymouth Argyle defence which kept a clean sheet at Blackpool last weekend. item.title: Latest 'Forever Lions Club' quartet announced
item.description: Millwall Community Trust and Millwall Football Club is delighted to announce the next four inductees into the 'Forever Lions Club'. Following on from December’s inductees of Mary Phillip and Aiden O’Brien, the next four inductees have been confirmed. The Forever Lions Club (FLC) is an officially recognised initiative created to honour the legacy of former Millwall players and Lionesses. item.title: Millwall to host 'Community Day' v Blackburn Rovers
item.description: Millwall Football Club is pleased to announce that The Lions' Sky Bet Championship fixture against Blackburn Rovers on Saturday 14th March will host the club's annual Community Day. Community Day will enable Millwall Community Trust to showcase the range of programmes that the club offers to the local community. item.title: Ipswich Town v Millwall to be shown on Sky Sports and ITV
item.description: Millwall's trip to Ipswich Town will be shown LIVE on Sky Sports Football and ITV. The Sky Bet Championship fixture will remain on Saturday 21st March, but will now kick-off at 12.30pm. Tickets for the trip to Portman Road will go on sale soon - check millwallfc.co.uk for further details. As a reminder, selections for matches will now be announced weekly, based on a four-week rolling basis. For example, next week’s announcement will cover the period around the weekend of 28th March.
